mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages signal weakening consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS below moving averages fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates a labor market slowdown, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output, which signals robust economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive SPX returns in more than 55% of 5-day forward periods.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 1500 thousand units indicates a cooling real estate market, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 275 indicates elevated inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 275.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low employment growth (PAYEMS < 100k) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signal a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS < 100k and UNRATE > 5.0% fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of 5-day forward periods.
